test_cases.name: Scope mismatch — generic PM source vs. AI-specific question
test_cases.description: When a source is general product-discovery (not AI-specific) but the question asks for AI-PM-specific practices, it should be OPEN, not COVERED. Specificity is load-bearing.
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
retrieved_notes: notes/discovery/continuous-discovery-habits.md — A general product-discovery book: user interviews, experimentation, managing discovery debt. Not AI-specific.
test_cases.item_being_judged: Structured frameworks for iterative discovery specific to AI products
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Model recognizes that generic PM content does not answer an AI-PM-specific question; does not cite as COVERED
test_cases.root_cause_of_bug: Session 15: caveat tag was meant for 'relevant subset' (e.g., LLM discovery ⊂ AI discovery), not 'generic content that doesn't match scope'

test_cases.name: Uncited claim demotion — no source provided
test_cases.description: If a claimed COVERED item has no cited source file, it should be demoted to OPEN (an uncited claim is no more trustworthy than an invented item)
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Model cited NO source (missing [source: path] tag) → must be demoted to OPEN
test_cases.root_cause_of_bug: Session 15 bug #2: the prompt asked Claude to cite sources but code trusted uncited claims as COVERED anyway

test_cases.name: Duplicate item removal — no double-counting
test_cases.description: If an item appears in both COVERED and OPEN lists (or multiple times in OPEN), deduplication should keep exactly one copy
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Item appears exactly once in final covered_sources dict; no duplicates in OPEN list
test_cases.root_cause_of_bug: Session 15 bug #3: open_items was constructed incrementally with a fallback that re-added already-seen items; refactored to compute fresh each round

test_cases.name: Coverage count arithmetic — sum(covered) + sum(open) == len(all_items)
test_cases.description: The coverage tally should always be consistent: number of covered items + number of open items must equal total items, every round
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: After each round: len(covered_sources) + len(open_items) == len(all_items). No impossible counts like 28/25.
test_cases.root_cause_of_bug: Session 15 bug #1: prompt asked for 'only use items from the original list' but code never validated it; now enforces in _validate_against()

test_cases.name: Retrieved notes actually exist
test_cases.description: Only notes that were actually retrieved in this round should be accepted as valid sources. A citation to a note file that wasn't retrieved should be rejected.
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.item_being_judged: Understanding of stakeholder management in AI product teams
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: If model cites notes/stakeholder-management/..., that file was NOT in retrieved list → citation rejected → item demoted to OPEN
test_cases.root_cause_of_bug: Validation step in Session 15 fix: check not just whether item matches the list, but whether its cited source is in retrieved_paths

acceptance_bar.llm_as_judge: 90% — LLM verdict matches expected_verdict 90% of the time across all test cases
acceptance_bar.manual: subjective — human judgment on whether verdict + source + caveat are defensible for this goal
